Self.Wiki: This map object represents a form of collision used to connect different maps together. When the player steps on a ConnectCollision, the specified map(s) will be loaded.

ParentHitName.Wiki: The collision this connection belongs to: the map in Map ID is loaded while standing on it.

MapID.Wiki: The map to load, as four numbers (mAA_BB_CC_DD). -1 counts as 0.
